svg.title: The Library and AI
svg.desc: A new capture is described by AI and gets its tags. Searching for invoice finds a receipt by the text inside it. Its details show the AI description, category and tags; a tag is added and its text is copied. Then the Recordings filter shows the recordings, with Play and Edit on hover.
